samples.summary: Storage key naming is inconsistent with the repo's existing conventions: notes uses colon-separated `wafflebase:notes:viewMode`, board uses dot-separated `wafflebase.board.grid`, and this adds a third style, `wafflebase-date-format`.

Layering: the Settings page now imports `formatExactDate` / `formatRelativeTime` from `@/app/documents/document-list-utils`, coupling an unrelated route to the documents feature module. The preference type already lives in `@/lib`; the generic date formatters would sit more naturally there (or in a `lib/date-format` module) alongside it.

verdict.reason: Verified independently: the PR adds a new persisted user-preference subsystem (packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts:13-94 — DateDisplayFormat type, localStorage key "wafflebase-date-format" at :17, custom "wafflebase-date-format-change" event at :24, useDateFormat() useSyncExternalStore hook at :90) plus Settings and documents-list consumers, but no design doc under docs/design/ documents it. docs/design/frontend.md documents the structurally identical Theme System preference (lines 534-545, "vite-ui-theme" localStorage key, useTheme() hook) and is untouched — grep for date/Date in that file yields only unrelated hits. Repo-wide grep for wafflebase-date-format|useDateFormat|date-format-preference|DateDisplayFormat and a case-insensitive *.md grep for "Date Display"/"date display format" find only the two docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-{todo,lessons}.md task files and .agent-review artifacts. I also checked the doc the reviewer thought absent: docs/design/documents-last-modified.md DOES exist, but it is scoped entirely to backend Postgres Document.updatedAt ordering via the Yorkie DocumentRootChanged webhook (see its Summary/Proposal, lines 6-84, and its README.md:146 index entry) — it says nothing about a client-side date display format preference, so it is not a counterexample. CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16 and :55-63 require a feature/non-trivial change to write or update a doc under docs/design/ and explicitly treat docs/tasks/active/*-todo.md as a separate per-task execution plan, not the design doc. Under this lens's design-doc-discipline rubric a missing required design doc is a major fit violation, so the finding stands.
